disposition_reason: Reports lead, copper, iron and zinc by AAS in manually extracted melon, groundnut and shea butter oils.

study.origin: seeds and kernels from Monday Market, New Bussa, Kainji Lake area, Niger State, Nigeria
study.method: traditional manual oil extraction; digestion (unspecified) and flame AAS (Buck 210 VGP) per AOAC 2000
study.qa: triplicate analysis; reagent blank mentioned for anti-nutrients; no CRM or recovery

findings.group: manually extracted at laboratory from seeds bought at Monday Market, New Bussa
findings.notes: mean ± SD of triplicate analysis; Table 2 header prints no unit, text and abstract give mg/kg; manually extracted oil from seeds bought at a market; 0.0002-0.0004 mg/kg (0.2-0.4 µg/kg) is far below typical flame AAS detection capability and no LOD is reported
